build_SemanticPredOwlvit: build a SemanticPredOwlvit instance that loads the OwlViT model for object detection on images
run_get_prediction: run get_prediction on an image to detect objects and return a semantic map with bounding boxes
run_compress_sem_map: run compress_sem_map to collapse a multi-channel semantic map into a single-channel compressed map
review_SemanticPredOwlvit_get_prediction: review the get_prediction method to understand how bounding boxes and labels are extracted from OwlViT outputs
refactor_compress_sem_map: refactor compress_sem_map to vectorize the loop and improve performance on large semantic maps
